title: What's New: Financial Management - Overview (2024 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Introduction and Overview of Financial Management Improvements
GL Revaluation and Currency Code Features
New Excel Reports for Financial Analysis

features.name: GL Revaluation and Currency Code on GL Entries
features.description: Allows specification of accepted currencies for each GL account. Users can restrict currencies to local only, allow multiple currencies, or allow any currency. Includes an adjustment badge job to create revaluation entries that can be reviewed before posting.

features.name: Excel Reports for Financial Data
features.description: Eight new Excel reports in the first batch including trial balances, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and customer/vendor lists. Reports are aggregated with multiple report pages and optional pivot tables. Total roadmap includes 25-30 reports.
features.status_evidence_quote: suffixed with a preview tag because we expect to make changes to them and small improvements
caveats: aggregated data, not full database copy
detailed data will come in minor releases
restrictions and limitations on data volume

features.name: Consolidation Currency Management
features.description: Improved consolidation process with ability to look up and manage currency exchange rates during consolidation runs. Users can recover from mistakes by looking up previous runs and picking rates from prior consolidations.

features.name: Collection Management Role Center
features.description: New role center for accounts receivable administrator with navigation and cues for tracking outstanding invoices, balances, and collection activities. Part of broader effort to improve collection and accounts receivable processes.

features.name: Reminder Process Improvements
features.description: Enhanced reminder setup and sending process with ability to tailor email text for different reminder levels. Added automation for creating and sending reminders to reduce manual effort.

features.name: Zero Lines in Recurring Journals
features.description: Ability to keep zero-amount lines in general recurring journals when using the fixed method. Previously blocked as an error, this now allows users to maintain recurring lines for payroll, accruals, and revenue recognition even when zero-amount in a given period.
caveats: only applies to fixed method recurring journals
zero lines are ignored during posting, not posted as zero

features.name: Currency Posting to Employee Ledger
features.description: Enables currency selection and posting to employee ledgers, similar to customer and vendor functionality. Allows tracking of employee transactions in foreign currencies and adjustment of balances if needed. Shows currency information in general ledger.
caveats: feature was introduced a few years back with local currency only
